name: Infinite WebGL Grid
description: Full-screen WebGL image grid that wraps infinitely in every direction. Drag, touch or scroll to pan it with eased motion, and the tiles stretch slightly while moving.
contents: Full-viewport WebGL canvas rendering a grid of cover-fit image planes
Hidden DOM grid used to measure plane positions
behavior: Drag with mouse or finger, or use the wheel or trackpad, to pan the grid endlessly with lerped easing
Each column moves at a slightly different speed for a parallax feel
Tiles shrink briefly in proportion to pan velocity
Canvas and plane sizes update on window resize
editableByProps: Grid size, easing, distortion, drag and wheel speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the tile gap or inset

fixed: Window-level mouse, touch and wheel listeners are added and removed on unmount
The WebGL canvas is fixed to the viewport
